_note: Single source of truth shared by music.py (audio) and main.js (picture). At 120 BPM one bar is 2 s, so bar n starts at 2n seconds. A cue ('at') is seconds, an event name, or an event name plus or minus seconds ('c1Red-0.25').

terms._note: Terminal panels, keyed by the DOM id of the panel. A line is a command ('cmd', typed at the panel's cps after the prompt 'ps', default '$'), an output line ('out'), or a boxed hook message ('box', revealed left to right). 'cls' colors a line, 'note' adds a pill after it, 'status' drives the panel's statusline. Sources: t1 and t4a-c are what claude/hooks/luciazero-verify.sh and luciazero-statusline.sh print in the stop, strict, exact-match and committed-settings cases (the traceback between its first and last line cut); t2 is the /done report format from skills/done/SKILL.md with example values; t5 is skills/done/scripts/revert-probe.sh on a two-commit demo repo, its two result lines wrapped; tBis is skills/bisect/scripts/safe-bisect.sh on a 12-commit demo repo, the criterion, its runner lines and the traceback cut and the SHAs of the checkout lines shortened; relayA/relayB are a cross-machine run of skills/lucia-relay/scripts/relay.py (draft --recipient cross-machine, finalize --envelope-out, then inspect and consume --verified with --trusted-envelope) on the relay-demo.sh fixture plus one test commit, pushed to a local stand-in for an SSH remote as tests/gates/relay.sh does: the paths shortened to ~/app and ~/envelope.json, the base SHA illustrative, the long commands and Next: wrapped, and left out: git push's first line, the receiver's cd, tag fetch and checkout of the relayed HEAD, the envelope JSON finalize prints and the first CONSUMED line; tBusA/tBusB are bin/lucia with a stand-in provider, the binding ids shortened, and the nudge line is nudge.note for one task from a codex sender; tWatch is plain lucia watch (every agent) on the state bash docs/assets/agent-bus-demo.sh leaves, its five messages (task, finding, the fix task to codex-implementer, its artifact, the result), the state path shortened, the column padding narrowed and the JSON payloads cut shorter; tLog is lucia status and the demo's own lines from that run, plus the refusals the daemon returned in a scratch session. lucia._note: Lucia presents the caught scenes and 'safe to try' from the right edge. Each line is a speech bubble shown from 'at' to 'end', said with a motion clip (a name render.mjs serves) and VRM expression weights; the music pops a bubble sound at each 'at'. 'caught' are the moments each FAILURE tag turns into CAUGHT: a stamp pops beside her and the music plays a jingle.

cuts._note: Shorter edits of the same film. A shot is a range of this timeline ('src', its own times, so every cue above still holds inside it) or a full-frame chapter card ('card', the id of a .card in index.html, held for 'dur' seconds over 'chord'). main.js plays the shots in order, music.py places each sound at its shot's time and drops the sounds of the ranges left out, and verify.py checks the cues that remain. 'safeItems' is how many items of 'Safe to try' the cut shows. A cut needs its own 'file' and 'music' names, and its last shot must be a range that runs to the timeline's end, so the fade-out is kept.
